map.输入净利润与营业收入，计算净利率，反映最终盈利占收入比重，适用于盈利质量评估、经: Enter net profit and operating revenue to calculate net margin, reflecting the share of revenue that ends as final profit, for earnings quality assessment, operating benchmarking and investor financial statement analysis.
map.净利率 = 净利/收入 × 100%: Net margin = net profit / revenue x 100%
map.净利率 = 净利润 / 营业收入。: Net margin = net profit / operating revenue.
map.衡量企业最终盈利水平，反映收入转化为净利润的效率。: Measures a company's final profitability and reflects how efficiently revenue converts into net profit.
map.对比同行业，评估经营效率与费用控制能力。: Benchmark against peers to assess operating efficiency and cost control.
map.投资者用净利率趋势判断企业盈利能力的变化方向。: Investors use the net margin trend to judge the direction of change in a company's profitability.
map.：某公司净利润 150 万元、营业收入 1000 万元，净利率=150/1000: : a company with net profit of 1.5 million CNY and operating revenue of 10 million CNY has a net margin of 1.5/10 = 15%, meaning each 1 CNY of revenue finally keeps 0.15 CNY as net profit.
map.由净利润、折旧摊销与营运资本变动求 OCF: Compute OCF from net profit, depreciation and amortization, and working capital changes
map.净利率受哪些因素影响最大？: Which factors affect net margin the most?
map.毛利率决定空间，期间费用率（销售/管理/研发）、利息与税负决定侵蚀程度；降本增效: Gross margin sets the room available, while period expense ratios (selling/administrative/R&D), interest and taxes determine how much is eroded; cost reduction, efficiency gains and sound tax planning all raise net margin.
map.净利率忽高忽低正常吗？: Is it normal for net margin to swing widely?
map.一次性损益（资产处置、政府补助、减值）会让净利率波动；看扣非净利率更能反映主业持: One-off gains and losses (asset disposal, government grants, impairment) make net margin volatile; the recurring net margin better reflects sustainable core profitability.
